digest.component_or_area: contract test for operation snapshot composition across CLI/Python/MCP/reconciler surfaces
propositions: The AC1 equivalence contract in test_operation_snapshot_surfaces.py fails to exercise real MCP and reconciler entry points; instead it re-calls the shared composer with identical arguments, making the cross-surface comparison vacuous and unable to detect parity bugs.
MCP surface assertions must invoke build_server() + call_tool() on a real server and capture snapshots emitted through the actual _shadow instrumentation rather than re-composing locally.
Reconciler surface assertions must invoke rebar_reconciler.__main__.main() with argv and --dry-run-enumerate, capturing snapshots emitted through _emit_operation_shadow at the real entry point.
Each surface block must fail explicitly (by name) if its entry point stops routing through compose_operation_snapshot, guarded by verifying the recorder captured at least one snapshot.

Cross-surface snapshot equality alone is insufficient; each surface must anchor its composed snapshot to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys with known provenance) to discriminate when the composer is perturbed.
